pr_title: Add bezier preset and refactor bezier editor
pr_body:
Co-authored-by: Razoric480 <razoric480@gmail.com>

Supersedes/Salvaged #57920.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/61938263/185730620-ac326ae8-4698-4efa-9a9f-a02a8b5a1290.png) ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/61938263/185730630-43ebdcb2-0993-4520-882b-ecd7b29cbb8b.png)


Add a Bezier preset. Also corrected incorrect signals (#64097). `handle_mode` is now only a valid property if `TOOLS = true`.

The undo-redo is not working, but it is broken before this PR, so it has nothing to do with this PR itself and will need to be fixed later.

Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/3561. Fixes #64097.
pr_comments:
@TokageItLab 
Code looks great and solves the issues that were raised in the previous PR. Thanks for picking up my slack :) It's appreciated.

Compiled and gave it a spin. A couple apparent bugs:
- Using right click to insert a new key does not cause a redraw, until you do something that does refresh. Only then does the new keyframe appears.
- Focus with no keyframe selected seems to break <kbd>F</kbd>ocusing, zooming out to minimum and having an error state vertically. I suspect changes to animation_bezier_editor.cpp's focus logic around the 875-901 lines. Not sure if the bug was there before. If we have no keyframes selected, maybe we should just focus on the length of the animation horizontally and the height of the top keyframes vertically.
- Since #55030 seem to have gotten partly reverted. All curves draw simultaneously, but they cannot be selected simultaneously. Not sure if this happened here, or if something else happened since that PR and this one.

Other than those three things, it works quite well.
@Razoric480 Thank you for testing, I'll take a look later.

@Razoric480 

> Using right click to insert a new key does not cause a redraw, until you do something that does refresh. Only then does the new keyframe appears.

Fixed.

> Since https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/55030 seem to have gotten partly reverted. All curves draw simultaneously, but they cannot be selected simultaneously. Not sure if this happened here, or if something else happened since that PR and this one.

It seems to be a regression that occurred in #57920. Fixed.

> Focus with no keyframe selected seems to break Focusing, zooming out to minimum and having an error state vertically. I suspect changes to animation_bezier_editor.cpp's focus logic around the 875-901 lines. Not sure if the bug was there before. If we have no keyframes selected, maybe we should just focus on the length of the animation horizontally and the height of the top keyframes vertically.

It seems to be a bug that occurred in master before this PR. I don't think it is critical for now, so I think we can fix it in Beta or later if you need.

I have to say, the icons are very hard to read. Especially the difference between free and balanced. The key part to distinguish them is the handles, and they are the least visible. Can we do something about it?

@Razoric480 Lovely! They are still very tiny (for the amount of detail they need), which may hinder the experience for some, but it's not something we can fix per icon and more of an overall issue. Definitely clearer this way!
Fixed problems around Undo/Redo. The main problem seemed to be with redrawing timing.

issue_context.title: Bezier editor in animation player has no inspector for keyframes
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

v4.0.alpha.custom_build [862da78ee]

### System information

Linux Fedora, Radeon RX 590

### Issue description

When clicking on keyframes in the bezier editor in 4.x, there is no inspector for the keyframes, which makes inserting precise values highly challenging.

Godot3:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7917475/183386323-cb1da69c-acd4-4ab9-a803-aae9a0540f28.png)

Godot4
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7917475/183385415-367b83ae-9acd-45d1-a94a-555d95d6af36.png)


### Steps to reproduce

Create an animation with curve keyframes, open the curve editor, observe no inspector.

### Minimal reproduction project

_No response_
comments:
Perhaps there is an error getting the key? I think the inspector process is not being performed due to the error. 

The key selection signal argument in the Bezier Editor was incorrect and has been fixed in #64647. Please check if that fixes it.

review_comments: These can likely be removed too I think.
This is necessary if Enum is used as a function argument. It can be removed if we are using an int as a function argument instead.
Well, I recommend leaving this as is. If you must remove this, please let me know again.
